text.tspan: Legislative procedure – Simplification of the medical devices rules – COM(2025) 1023 (proposal)

Procedure 2025/0404(COD). State as of 12 Nov 2026: steps done and in progress are marked. Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see medical-devices-simplification.html).
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading, or, after the EP first reading, to an early second reading.
13 Feb 2026 · SANT rapporteur appointed (Oliver Schenk, PPE)
25 Mar 2026 · Referral to committee announced in plenary
